about_the_game:
Game Features:

  • Romanceable Characters: All characters are younger than the protagonist.

  • Game Background: An alternate modern - day setting.

  • This official version will add mini-games such as enhancing the sense of experience or interactivity to the plot on the basis of traditional visual novel gameplay.

    In addition to influencing the direction of the story, it seems that the mini-games will also be related to your choices.

Story Background:
You've just entered the second semester of high school. As the class monitor trusted by everyone, you're determined to regain the class's glory in this Spring Festival. However, everything seems a bit different from before.

Character Introduction:

  • Izumi Reiai (Female protagonist, only the name can be changed)
    As a responsible person, you chose to be the class monitor. You have a jellyfish - like hairstyle that is as light as feathers. You are rigorous and reliable, often helping students outside of your class solve problems. Everyone thinks, "If the class monitor were a character in a shoujo manga, she would definitely be a refreshing and handsome prince - like character." Unfortunately, your memory is a bit poor. Once you encounter a problem, you will record detailed information in a notebook you carry with you for analysis. Even when facing emotions, you are used to solving your doubts in this way.
    —— "What is love?" You write down a series of keywords while analyzing.
    You are not influenced by others and don't care about what others think. As a result, in occasions you think are unimportant, you will wear some unexpected combinations. And you embrace the things you love without hesitation, so you have a wide range of interests. You like desserts and cute things the most. Because of this, you became obsessed with the unpopular cartoon "Cosmic Gourmet Luluko".

  • Imahara Hibiki (Romanceable character, transfer student)
    He is the heir of a well - known kabuki family who is good at playing female roles. He is also a transfer student who looks similar to you. But after becoming your deskmate, what you see hidden under his noble appearance is...
    "Is that... merchandise of Lady Luluko?"
    And there is a social - exclusive mode just for you - the tea - flavored mille - feuille routine.
    "Class monitor."
    "Would you like to try calling me by my name?"
    "Classmate Inuaki seems to have a really good relationship with the class monitor."
    "... I'm glad you like it. If you like it, you can eat it all."
    "Would you like to have a taste?"

  • Inuaki (Romanceable character, deskmate)
    Under his sharp pretense is a very delicate - minded person. As a fashion genius who skipped grades and became your deskmate, he carefully takes care of his hairstyle every day and has a great passion for geometric design elements. Although he is always unforgiving in words, he only shows his soft side to you.
    "Because I was thinking about you, I unconsciously wanted to make them."
    "I'm really happy to be able to design clothes that you like..."

  • Rika (Romanceable character, junior student)
    Due to his strong curiosity and a lonely childhood, he never relies on others and is only used to finding answers in books. Although he is the study committee member of the class, and his outstanding appearance and excellent academic performance have made him a popular figure among junior students. But everyone's impression of him is - that top - student who is not easy to get along with. The world he built with books was torn open a small hole by you, and you explore the definition of "love" together.
    "Will we meet again tomorrow?"
    "The focus of my eyes is a bit unstable... It's not the problem of my glasses."
    "I seem to understand why I couldn't understand this emotion just by reading books."
    ……
    "I like you, I like you the most, senior."

  • Izumi Kyoichi (Non - romanceable character, older brother)
    He is gentle and calm, taking meticulous care of you. He is the "perfect older brother" in everyone's eyes.
    "Let me do these things."
    But at some point, this feeling has quietly changed. The innocence of youth, the bond of family affection, and the hidden love are intertwined.
    "This is the care that is taken for granted among family members."
    "... So, this kind of feeling can only be what an 'older brother' has, right?"
    "It's okay to rely on your older brother all the time."
    "As long as you will be happy."

  • Narukawa (Non - romanceable character, childhood friend)
    Your existence is his only belonging. He always takes it for granted that he is your possession. Everything about him has grown around you since you met.
    "Let me take your surname."
    "Anyway, from the very beginning, I've been yours."

  • Luluko (Special character)
    This is a character from an unpopular children's cartoon in the game's worldview. She is an alien cosmic gourmet who mimics the Earth's giraffe.

short_description: This spring, your campus life is quietly changing. You start to ponder what the relationships between you all really mean. The throbbing of youth, the intimate bonds, and the hidden feelings are intertwined, waiting for your choices.
